text:
Amazon Bedrock: new zero data retention text on the data handling page as of Nov 24.
Before: "...to previous model retention behavior; if ZDR applied previously, then ZDR still applies."
After: "There is no change to previous model retention behavior."
https://inference-index.vercel.app/changelog

entry.before: There is no change to previous model retention behavior; if ZDR applied previously, then ZDR still applies.
